Business Discovery and Solution Design
  
  

* Participate in discovery sessions with business stakeholders to understand workflows, data sources, pain points, and opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.

* Identify appropriate boundaries for agent autonomy, human review, approvals, and deterministic business rules.

AI and Agentic Application Engineering
  
  

* Build LLM-powered applications and agentic workflows using tool calling, enterprise APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, and state management.

Data and Software Engineering

Security and responsible AI

You will sit in Core Engineering and work every day with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Solution Architecture. You will build the agents and automated workflows our business teams have asked for, and you will build them on the Databricks lakehouse that is Fluent's data hub, because the hard part of most of these workflows is not the model. Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
  
  
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
  
  
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

Why this team?
  
  
Internal Infrastructure builds the infrastructure and tools used to train, evaluate, and serve Cohere's foundation models. You will work with AI researchers and ML engineers on stability, scalability, and observability. The work accelerates the models behind Cohere's platform, North.
  
  
You will build the platform that runs training, evaluation, and reinforcement-learning workloads: job lifecycle, scheduling, workload networking, and the storage those jobs depend on. The role includes a compensated 24x7 on-call rotation.

* Work with the data infrastructure team on storage for checkpoints and other training artifacts.

Fluent is building the next generation advertising network: Partner Monetize and Advertiser Acquisition. Our vision is to build an ML/AI first network of advertisers and publishers working toward a common objective, elevating relevancy in e-commerce for everyday shoppers.
  
  
Fluent is hiring its first dedicated AI Engineer. Over the past year, AI at Fluent has moved from pilots to production: a service desk agent that closes tickets without a human touch, a pipeline that cut modeled audience delivery from days to hours, and an agent that audits cross-system attribution and identifies revenue reconciliation opportunities. All of it was built by people doing it alongside their day jobs. Your job is to make it your day job.
  
  
You will sit in Core Engineering and work every day with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Solution Architecture. You will build the agents and automated workflows our business teams have asked for, and you will build them on the Databricks lakehouse that is Fluent's data hub, because the hard part of most of these workflows is not the model. It is getting trusted data and reliable actions in front of it.
  
  
You are a builder who ships. You are strong in Python and SQL, you have put at least one LLM-powered application in front of real users, and you know the difference between a demo and a production system: evaluation, monitoring, cost, and a clear owner. You have worked in Databricks or a comparable lakehouse, or you have the data engineering depth to get productive there quickly. You are comfortable sitting with a support lead or an account manager, understanding how they actually work, and turning that into something that runs every day. This role is fully remote in the United States, with occasional travel to our New York headquarters.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Ship production agents and automated workflows from a prioritized, business-validated backlog. Own each one from scoping with the business owner through build, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and handoff.

Bring data from our ad-serving and partner platforms, CRM, support desk, and finance systems into one place people can trust.

* Integrate with Fluent's systems through APIs, webhooks, MCP servers, and orchestration (Databricks Workflows, n8n, GitHub Actions), and replace brittle point-to-point automations with maintained, observable ones.

* Handle consumer data in line with Fluent's privacy and compliance standards, use only approved AI tools, and work with IT & Security on credentials and access.

* Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot review) as a normal part of how you work.

In your first 90 days you will have shipped one workflow end to end, with a named business owner and numbers Finance can validate. **Description**
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
On Agentic WorkSpaces, our vision is to enable AI agents to work the way humans do — with access to real applications, real interfaces, and real computing environments. For enterprises to trust autonomous agents with their essential business applications, they need a full suite of governance capabilities: an identity for every agent, human-in-the-loop controls to audit and approve what agents do, and the ability for a human intervene in an agent's session when required. Our team is building these systems end to end. Upcoming launches will give every agent a verifiable identity, record every desktop action as a reviewable visual audit trail, enforce policy on every tool call before it executes, pause agents for human approval on sensitive actions, and let a human take control of an agent's session mid-task before handing it back to the agent, which resumes with full context of what changed. Identity and agentic governance present hard problems in our industry today, and we're excited to on the forefront of solving them.
  
  
We're looking for an SDE II who can ramp quickly deliver features end-to-end and thrive in greenfield work. Much of what we're building doesn't exist yet. You'll take early designs to production make pragmatic calls about what to build versus what to compose from existing AWS services and ship on a schedule tied to real customer milestones. The pace is high with re:Invent deliverables targeted for this year and an ambitious 2027 roadmap. If you like owning features from design through production and want your work to be the reason enterprises trust AI agents this team is for you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own features end-to-end: design implement test deploy and operate in production
* Build new services for policy enforcement, session recording and replay, human-in-the-loop approval workflows, and human takeover of agent sessions
* Integrate with AWS services and make build-vs-compose decisions with your team
* Handle customer content with care: recording pipelines retention and access controls where correctness is the product
* Collaborate with engineers on adjacent teams to unblock dependencies and align on interfaces
* Contribute to operational excellence: oncall runbooks alarms and incident response

A day in the life
  
  
Your mornings are usually free for focus work - writing code reviewing CRs and working through whatever problem you've picked up. Around 11 you'll have standup then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for integration work cross-team syncs or design reviews. Our pipelines are full CD our ticket queue is small and when something pages us we fix the root cause - not just the symptom. We encourage responsible AI usage across our development workflow - it's one way our team moves fast. The problems are interesting and the pace is high but we believe we can move fast do exceptional work and have a full life outside of it.
